title: Two Plays (Tartuffe & The Would-Be Gentleman) by Moliere - Easton Press
descriptionText: This collector's edition of Two Plays by Molière is a must-have for any book enthusiast. The leather binding and Easton Press publisher make this book a valuable addition to any collection. The author's clever comedies are sure to entertain readers and make this book a beloved classic. Perfect for anyone interested in antiquarian and collectible books.
